How it works

Four steps, about three weeks.
  1. 1

    Tell us about your group.

    Name, goal, dates and where you practise. Your team page is ready within one business day.

  2. 2

    Share your link.

    Every player or family gets their own link, so you can see who sold what. Post it in your team app, text it, or print the QR flyer.

  3. 3

    Families order online.

    Supporters pay J&W directly. You never handle cash or product. Your group's share shows under every price.

  4. 4

    One drop, then you get paid.

    We bring every order, bagged and labelled by name, to your arena or hall on our route day. Your group's money arrives by e-transfer or cheque within 10 business days.

    Questions organizers ask

    The ones a principal or club board asks first.
    Do we have to pre-buy anything?+

    No. Families pay J&W online when they order. You never hold cash or product.

    When do we get paid?+

    Within 10 business days of your drop, by e-transfer or cheque, with a statement of every order.

    Is this a donation? Do buyers get tax receipts?+

    No. Your group's share is a fundraising payment from J&W, not a charitable donation, so we don't issue tax receipts.

    Can you deliver to our school?+

    School boards have their own fundraising and food rules. We send your principal a one-page school pack. Until your board says yes to a school drop, families can pick up free at Brimley Rd or choose home delivery.

    What if a family misses the drop?+

    We take their order back to Brimley Rd frozen and hold it 3 days for free pickup (Mon–Fri 9–6, Sat 10–4).

    Allergies, pork and halal?+

    Every pack comes with an ingredient and allergen sheet before your campaign starts, and our coordinator confirms anything specific. The Freezer Pack, Game-Week Pack and Kids Combo list no pork. The Long Weekend Box includes sausages and ribs. We don't label packs halal or kosher.

    Can relatives outside Ontario help?+

    Yes, if the food stays here. We deliver only in Ontario because our plant is provincially inspected. A grandparent in BC can buy a pack for a team family to pick up at the drop.

    How long should a campaign run?+

    Two weeks works well: open on a Monday, close on a Sunday, drop the next week on our route day.

    Where do you do team drops?+

    On our weekly routes: Tuesday in Durham (Pickering to Port Perry), Wednesday in Toronto, Scarborough, North York, Etobicoke and Mississauga, Thursday from Oakville to Hamilton, Friday in York and Peel. Farther away, families choose home delivery on our long routes.
